map.desc: Efficient Harvesting: Makes you gain an additional Wheat when mining Hay Bales.
Zoomies: +50% Base Ground Speed, stacks with Weaved Harvester VI.
Glided String: +50% Chance for +1 Golden String, stacks with Shears.
Vault Storage: Unlocks @bank, allowing infinite storage of 3 items.
Capitalism: 0.1% chance to get money when anyone sells wheat.
Communism: 0.1% chance to get wheat when anyone breaks a haybale.
Hay Breaker: Whenever the wheat area resets, breaking a hay bale counts as breaking 1.5 hay bales.
